context: Asuka lectures on the welfare system.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: civics lecture; vocabulary (保障/介護/普及/要望/規則) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会保障は、皆を支える仕組みです。
lines.en: Social security is a system that supports everyone.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 介護も、保障に含まれますか?
lines.en: Is care included in the security too?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、介護も大切な保障の一つです。
lines.en: Yes, care is one important part of the security.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 制度は、どう普及したんですか?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 市民の要望で、普及が進みました。
lines.en: It spread thanks to citizens' requests.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 規則は、誰が決めるんですか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 議会が、規則を定めます。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 要望を伝えるのも、大切なんですね。
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
